turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting Acme.  How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, the reason I contact you is because im trying to use a promo code but it doesnt work

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that, but let's see if I can clear that up for you

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ok thanks

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I ask your full name, so that I can take a look at your account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: that would be great

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Joseph Banter

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Joseph Banter.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, Mr. Banter, I can see your account now

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sometimes our promo codes are only valid for a limited time, usually a week, do you know when your code was issued?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: it was issued about 8 days ago

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: maybe thats why it doest work

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Querying the system for an answer ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, I'm checking in our system now, and the code that was most recently tried on your account has indeed expired

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: However, depending on your membership level, I may be able to provide a new code for you

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh thats too bad,

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: it would be great if you could help me

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: are you a member of our site, or were you using the site as a guest?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I really want those boots

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: im a guest

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Oh, I'm sorry, I could only issue a replacement promo code to one of our existing members

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thats too bad

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I guess I will have to wait for another discount then

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Indeed, I'm sorry I couldn't be of any more assistance

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No problem I understand

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Are there any other issues that I could help you with while we are here?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: no that would be all

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: thanks

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You too.  Have a good day
